name: Fermilab — Batavia, Illinois
notes: Far sites (not drawn on this map; see the geometry worklog for great-circle distances and bearings computed from the sourced site:fermilab-main-campus point): site:soudan-minos-far-detector (735.4 km, bearing 336.0 degrees, historical MINOS-era NuMI beam), site:ash-river-nova-far-detector (811.7 km, bearing 335.5 degrees, current NOvA-era NuMI beam), site:surf-4850-level-dune-far-detector (1287.6 km, bearing 287.7 degrees, LBNF beam). No map:soudan, map:ash-river or map:surf record exists yet in this branch, so linked_map_ids is empty; the integrator should populate it once those maps exist.

The campus site (site:fermilab-main-campus, a 3 km point) is represented by the campus boundary and by the halls/points drawn at it with `site_id`; detectors placed there that could not be located are listed individually in `unlocated[]`.

QA pass (2026-09-21): detector:seaquest and site:fermilab-nm4-hall are no longer unlocated. An independent QA re-derivation found (and this reviewer independently re-confirmed with a direct fetch) OpenStreetMap node 4425992583, tagged name=SeaQuest, addr:housenumber=NM4, in the campus bbox -- the prior 'no OSM trace' reason was narrowly true (a search for the literal string 'NM4' finds nothing) but gave a false overall impression, since a search for the experiment's own name finds it directly. Now drawn as geometry:fermilab-seaquest-point.

Release pass (2026-10-25): the Main Injector and Recycler are drawn. The Main Injector's shape is computed from the TDR's straight-section lengths, dipole counts and lattice listing and its position fitted to the private service road around it (derived, accuracy 30 m; see geometry:fermilab-main-injector-ring for the derivation, the independent 28.789277 m check, and the 9 m agreement with the OSM 'MI-62' building). The earlier 'grassland' polygon geometry:fermilab-mi-infield remains context only.

summary.plain: Fermilab's main campus near Chicago, where the Booster and (until 2011) the Tevatron ring are drawn to scale from OpenStreetMap and their sourced sizes, along with the CDF, D0, MINOS, NOvA, MiniBooNE, MicroBooNE and ICARUS detector buildings and the Muon g-2 MC-1 building. Derived target points and beamline axes for the BNB and NuMI beams are reconstructed from OpenStreetMap building positions and sourced beam distances, not from a coarse campus point. The 3.3 km Main Injector and Recycler ring (one shared tunnel, an oval with eight straight sections, shape from the design handbook) is drawn; PIP-II, Mu2e and a few fixed-target detector halls could not be located precisely and are listed as unlocated. Arrows show the inferred direction of the NuMI and LBNF neutrino beams toward their far detectors in Minnesota and South Dakota, which are shown on separate maps.
summary.technical: Local to-scale map of the Fermilab Batavia campus: a derived circle for the Booster ring (474 m sourced circumference, OSM-fit centre) and for the Tevatron ring (6.3 km sourced circumference, OSM ring-road-fit centre, cross-checked against the OSM-sourced CDF and D0 hall positions); georeferenced/derived OSM building footprints for the CDF Hall, D0 Assembly Building, MINOS and NOvA near-detector surface buildings, MiniBooNE Detector Building, the LArTF/MicroBooNE hall, a positionally-identified ICARUS-T600 hall and the Muon g-2 MC-1 building; derived target_station/beamline features for BNB and NuMI, each anchored on two independently-named OSM footprints rather than a coarse site point, with passing distance/azimuth checks; an approximate linac axis; context-only campus boundary, Main Injector-area grassland and MC-2 polygons; and inferred-direction lines for the NuMI and LBNF beams, now starting from the derived NuMI target. PIP-II, KTeV, Mu2e, SBND (candidate footprints found but not confidently identified), MINERvA, DONUT, SENSEI, DAMIC (prototype) and the DUNE near detector are unlocated, each with a sourced reason and backlog. SeaQuest/NM4 was added by a QA pass (2026-09-21) as an OSM-tagged point (geometry:fermilab-seaquest-point). Release pass 2026-10-25: Main Injector and Recycler drawn as derived 3319 m rings (TDR lattice shape, placed on the Indian Creek Road offset; 30 m).

unlocated.backlog: Fetch the PIP-II CDR (FERMILAB-DESIGN-2017-01) or TDR civil chapter from a mirror other than lss.fnal.gov; or the IWAA 2024 talk (Bocean) with its site-layout slide read by a person and a published azimuth/coordinate of the linac front end; or re-check OSM once PIP-II civil works are mapped (a landuse=construction polygon near the Booster would anchor the 215 m straight section).
unlocated.reason: PIP-II is under construction 'in a new tunnel with new service buildings and connected to the present Booster through a new transfer line' (src:fermilab-geo-pip-ii-radiation-2018), with a site-plan figure referenced 'with respect to Fermilab Wilson Hall'; the 2024 alignment paper adds that the tunnel 'consists of a straight section and a curved section' with 'a total beam length of approximately 550 meters' (src:fermilab-geo-pip2-iwaa2024-krawczuk) and the 2024 alignment talk gives a 210 m linac tunnel and a 300 m transfer line. No coordinates, azimuth value or dimensioned site plan could be fetched (the official CDR/TDR on lss.fnal.gov returns HTTP 403; the IWAA 2024 slides carry the site layout as an image only; an OSM extract of the campus fetched 2026-10-25 holds no PIP-II way).

unlocated.backlog: Second pass (2026-09-18): found a candidate building, OSM way 720556732 'MC-2' (drawn as context only, geometry:fermilab-mc2-building), 84 m from the confirmed MC-1/g-2 building -- plausible given the MC-1/MC-2 naming pattern, but a WebSearch and two WebFetch attempts (arXiv:2208.02889 'Muon Campus at Fermilab', HTML and PDF) found no fetchable text confirming MC-2 is specifically the Mu2e hall. Also found the former Antiproton Source buildings AP-0/AP-10/AP-30/AP-50 (OSM, src:fermilab-geo-osm-muon-campus) clustered near 41.8346,-88.2656, candidate anchors for the adjacent Delivery Ring (ex-Debuncher, sourced as roughly triangular and ~505 m in circumference by the task brief, but no source fetched this session states its shape/circumference directly, and three building centroids are not enough to justify drawing a triangle without a sourced vertex/side correspondence) -- not drawn, but useful context for whoever resolves MC-2. Confirming either would let Mu2e become a drawn `hall`.
